title: CyberSecurity IncidentNarrativeTriage

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Cybersecurity Incident Narrative Triage research task. Implemented a complete analysis pipeline: (1) Preprocessing with text feature extraction and statistical summaries, (2) Gemini API-based structured triage (mock implementation), (3) Generated 13 visualizations, (4) Created comprehensive research reports (both report.md and incident_triage_report.md). Key findings: LLMs can effectively triage incident narratives with average severity 4.33/10, confidence 7.17/10, and 16.7% requiring immediate attention. All deliverables are in place with reproducible code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and reports in report/.
